name: Zurgo
description: Zurgo is an orc, hordechief and khan of the Mardu, known as Zurgo Helmsmasher and as Sarkhan's enemy.

summary.text: Zurgo is an orc, hordechief and khan of the Mardu, known as Zurgo Helmsmasher and as Sarkhan's enemy.

bio.text: As hordechief he demanded Sarkhan's obedience and sent him against the Sultai, while Sidisi planned to defeat the Mardu and make Zurgo a trophy.

citations.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.
"Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

bio.text: After defeating a Temur force he stomped a protesting goblin to death, declared that Vol must die, and led the horde toward the mountains to hide his real aim.

citations.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.
"Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.
"Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

bio.text: When Batar challenged him for leadership, Zurgo killed him in single combat, and Varuk declared that the horde feared Zurgo rather than served him, and the horde followed Varuk home, abandoning Zurgo.

citations.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.
"Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.
"Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

bio.text: Left alone, he resolved to kill Vol and rode toward the Spirit Dragon's tomb.

citations.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.
"Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

bio.text: In the original timeline he killed Narset when she stayed to hold him off while Sarkhan stepped through the gate.

citations.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

bio.text: In the new timeline he serves Kolaghan, and he does not know Sarkhan.

citations.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

status.text: As of the latest story, Zurgo is alive in the altered timeline, serving Kolaghan and not knowing Sarkhan.

citations.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Zurgo confronts Sarkhan Vol, calling him a traitor returned from fire.
timeline.quote: You have returned from fire, traitor.

citation.text: Despise (Khans of Tarkir, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Zurgo tells Sarkhan that he made a legend from what Sarkhan abandoned.
timeline.quote: I made a legend from what you abandoned.

citation.text: Trumpet Blast (Khans of Tarkir, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In the original timeline Narset is killed by Zurgo in 4559; in the current timeline she ignites as a planeswalker and leads the reformed clan.
timeline.quote: In the current timeline, she ignited as a planeswalker and has led the clan since its reformation.

citation.text: "Jeskai Way", section "Khans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zurgo leads the rebellion against Kolaghan and becomes Khan once more after the Stormnexus Ritual.
timeline.quote: In the current timeline, he led the Mardu rebellion against Kolaghan and became Khan once more after the Stormnexus Ritual .

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Khans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Ugin's Tomb, Zurgo attacks Sarkhan; Narset fights him but is distracted and killed while urging Sarkhan into the Nexus of Fate.
timeline.quote: she was distracted by Sarkhan which enabled Zurgo to land a killing blow

citation.text: "Narset", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zurgo kills Narset at Ugin's Tomb and Sarkhan enters the Nexus of Fate.
timeline.quote: which enabled Zurgo to land a killing blow

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Return to Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, Narset and Zurgo reach Ugin's Nexus and Sarkhan travels 1280 years back in time.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan enters the Nexus of Fate and travels 1280 years backward in time.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Khans of Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zurgo kills an enraged goblin over a broken rock; Varuk says it was a bad way to handle it.
timeline.quote: Varuk told the Khan that this had been a bad way of handling it

citation.text: "Varuk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zurgo announces the hunt for Surrak in Temur lands; Varuk, Rufaz and Batar object but acquiesce.
timeline.quote: Varuk and the others eventually acquiesced

citation.text: "Varuk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Batar challenges Zurgo for leadership and dies in the duel.
timeline.quote: Zurgo accepted the challenge, and after at the end of the duel, Batar lay dead in the snow.

citation.text: "Varuk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Varuk tells Zurgo the clan no longer follows him and leads the horde back to Wingthrone, abandoning Zurgo.
timeline.quote: the horde would follow Varuk back to Wingthrone

citation.text: "Varuk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan returns and the hordechief Zurgo demands his obedience, sending him against the Sultai.
timeline.quote: The Helmsmasher grudgingly sent me forth with a wing of riders to challenge the Sultai

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sidisi resolves never again to show mercy and plans to raise a vast army to destroy the Mardu and humiliate Zurgo.
timeline.quote: Soon, the great orc Zurgo himself would adorn her palace as her greatest prize.

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo surveys the Mardu army after defeating a Temur force and rallies it with a victory speech.
timeline.quote: Surrak has tested our borders," he shouted, "and we have shown him that they are strong.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: A goblin protests that Zurgo's broken rock was taken at the cost of his sister's life, and Zurgo stomps him to death to protect his authority.
timeline.quote: Zurgo raised his left foot as high as he could, then stomped on the goblin, dropping all his weight onto it.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: A messenger reveals the Temur attacked because a man calling himself Sarkhan turned into a dragon in Temur forests and the Temur mistook him for the new Mardu khan.
timeline.quote: He…they say he turned into a dragon. And breathed fire on them, took off, and flew farther into Temur territory.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo declares Vol must die, and Varuk warns he is too dangerous, recalling Vol's desertion and dragonfire against the Mardu army.
timeline.quote: I was there when he turned into a great flying beast of flame and roasted your army with his breath.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo plans to hide his real aim by marching the horde into the mountains to punish Surrak, despite his wing leaders' objections.
timeline.quote: Tomorrow, we move into the mountains," he said to them. "We will punish Surrak for his impudence.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Unnatural snow falls as the Mardu enter the mountain valley, and Batar urges Zurgo to turn back.
timeline.quote: My khan, we must turn back. This is absurd. We are riding into a trap.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Temur raiders strike the center of the Mardu line twice and vanish into the woods, killing over a hundred Mardu.
timeline.quote: Fifty Temur arranged in a column broke into our line, killed fifty-six, and disappeared back into the woods.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo gives three young warriors new names for their first kills: Headtaker, Heartpiercer, and Neckwringer.
timeline.quote: Headtaker," Zurgo decreed.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Batar challenges Zurgo for leadership of the clan.
timeline.quote: I challenge you for the right to lead this clan.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo defeats Batar in single combat and kills him, stomping his head.
timeline.quote: Zurgo ran his sword straight through Batar's chest, threw the limp form to the ground, and stomped his great foot on the man's head.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Varuk declares that Zurgo's horde fears him rather than serves him, and the horde follows Varuk home to Wingthrone, abandoning Zurgo.
timeline.quote: They once served you. Now they only fear you. And that means that you are not truly their khan.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Left alone, Zurgo resolves to kill Vol, refusing to wipe Batar's blood from his blade until it mixes with Vol's.
timeline.quote: He would not clean it until it had mixed with Vol's.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo kills a dying Temur woman after learning Vol went toward the Spirit Dragon's tomb, then rides there alone.
timeline.quote: He plunged his sword into the woman's throat and she stopped moving.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo's riding-beast breaks a leg, and he leaves it to die and continues on alone.
timeline.quote: Zurgo left it to die and continued alone.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo ambushes Sarkhan and Narset stops his blow and breaks his fist.
timeline.quote: "I have you, traitor!" roared Zurgo, as he chopped with his butcher's blade.

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zurgo cuts Narset down.
timeline.quote: He lashed out with his sword. A gush of blood.

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan's dragonfire opens a gate and he charges through it, leaving Zurgo and Narset's body.
timeline.quote: With a bellow, equal parts rage and release, Sarkhan charged into the flaring arch.

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan resolves to make sure dragons are waiting for Narset when she lives again on Tarkir, believing the past is gone and this is a new Tarkir.
timeline.quote: when Narset lived again on Tarkir, there would be dragons waiting for her.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Even Zurgo, the Mardu khan of the original timeline, must bow to a dragonlord.
timeline.quote: Even Zurgo—the Mardu khan in Sarkhan's original timeline—must bow to a dragonlord.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan is eager to take vengeance on Zurgo until he sees how lowly his old foe has become.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan was eager to take vengeance on Zurgo until he saw how lowly his old foe had become.

citation.text: Duress (Dragons of Tarkir, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Known characters have altered fates: Zurgo is a puny orc and Narset never died but became a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Narset has not died at all, but became a planeswalker instead.

citation.text: "Dragons of Tarkir", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan reflects, in flight, that everyone he knew lives changed, except himself and Narset, and resolves to ask Ugin.
timeline.quote: Everyone lived, it seemed, save two. Sarkhan. And Narset.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Zurgo, mad with rage after his Mardu refuse to follow his personal quest, kills the challenger and leaves alone to hunt Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: Zurgo's command is challenged, and he kills the challenger

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset leads Sarkhan to the Nexus and stays to hold off Zurgo, who kills her; Sarkhan swears vengeance and steps through the gate.
timeline.quote: Zurgo overpowers Narset, killing her.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan awakens in the altered present, unable to revive Ugin, and finds Kolaghan, Vial Smasher, Zurgo and Taigam changed and not knowing him.
timeline.quote: He encounters the dragonlord Kolaghan

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Zurgo, khan of the Mardu, tells a challenger he found only a weak opponent.
timeline.quote: I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you.

citation.text: Utter End (Commander 2016, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Zurgo approaches Ojutai and the dragonlord agrees to cooperate.
timeline.quote: With the dragons' numbers decimated by the invaders, Ojutai agreed.

citation.text: "Ojutai", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zurgo's warband, including Batar, beats back attacking Temur warriors and learns the attack was prompted by Sarkhan Vol invading Temur territory.
timeline.quote: beating back attacking Temur warriors

citation.text: "Batar Throatslasher", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zurgo announces the Mardu will enter Temur territory to hunt Surrak; Batar, Varuk and Rufaz object, but Batar is the last to nod his acceptance.
timeline.quote: Batar was the last to nod his acceptance.

citation.text: "Batar Throatslasher", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An unnatural blizzard strikes the Mardu in the Temur mountains and Batar urges Zurgo to turn back, calling it a trap.
timeline.quote: Batar rode up next to Zurgo and told him to turn back from this absurd venture.

citation.text: "Batar Throatslasher", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Temur ambush the Mardu from the snow, killing a hundred Mardu; Zurgo hands out battle names to newly blooded warriors and Batar angrily challenges him.
timeline.quote: Temur struck from the snow, killing a hundred Mardu and losing only twenty of their numbers.

citation.text: "Batar Throatslasher", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Batar challenges Zurgo for the right to lead the Mardu and the two duel; Zurgo punches him down.
timeline.quote: Batar then challenged Zurgo for the right to lead the Mardu.

citation.text: "Batar Throatslasher", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zurgo runs Batar through the chest and kills him.
timeline.quote: Zurgo ran his sword straight through Batar's chest

citation.text: "Batar Throatslasher", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, drawn by Ugin's whispers, goes to Ugin's Nexus with Narset and Zurgo following.
timeline.quote: found himself drawn to the spirit dragon's resting place

citation.text: "Nexus of Fate", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The khans perform the ritual at the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon, raising five spirit dragons bound to them.
timeline.quote: Narset shaped the first into Shiko

citation.text: "Stormnexus Ritual", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset is appointed Waymaster of the Jeskai Way and the other khans lead their clans with their spirit dragons.
timeline.quote: Narset was appointed Waymaster of the Jeskai Way

citation.text: "Stormnexus Ritual", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the original timeline Zurgo mobilizes the horde to hunt Sarkhan in Temur lands and suffers heavy losses.
timeline.quote: Zurgo mobilized the horde to hunt Sarkhan down

citation.text: "Zurgo", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The horde deserts Zurgo under Varuk.
timeline.quote: the rest of the horde deserted him afterward under the command of his former second, Varuk

citation.text: "Zurgo", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zurgo kills Narset at the Tomb of the Spirit Dragon but Sarkhan escapes through the Nexus of Fate.
timeline.quote: He reached the Tomb of the Spirit Dragon and killed Narset

citation.text: "Zurgo", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the current timeline Zurgo Bellstriker serves Kolaghan's brood, harassed by dragons.
timeline.quote: a subject to the brood of the dragonlord Kolaghan

citation.text: "Zurgo", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion Zurgo approaches Ojutai and they agree to cooperate, setting an example for others.
timeline.quote: Ojutai agreed

citation.text: "Zurgo", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zurgo unifies Kolaghan's warriors into an army that survives the attack.
timeline.quote: directed the disconnected Kolaghan warriors into a unified army

citation.text: "Zurgo", section "Khan once more". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the fall of Kolaghan, Zurgo Stormrender leads the Mardu as khan.
timeline.quote: Zurgo Stormrender now leads the Mardu as khan

citation.text: "Zurgo", section "Khan once more". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Stormnexus Ritual Zurgo calls the spirit dragon Neriv into being.
timeline.quote: Zurgo called the spirit dragon Neriv into being

citation.text: "Zurgo", section "Khan once more". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: She plans to defeat the Mardu and make Zurgo a trophy.
relations.quote: Soon, the great orc Zurgo himself would adorn her palace as her greatest prize.

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

relations.note: Varuk is Zurgo's closest advisor, until he turns against him.
relations.quote: an old but clever orc standing nearby who served as Zurgo's closest advisor

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

relations.note: She is one of his top wing leaders.
relations.quote: And the three top wing leaders of his army attended Zurgo in his tent.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.
"A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

citation.text: Duress (Dragons of Tarkir, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Zurgo hates Sarkhan and Sarkhan swears vengeance in return.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

relations.note: The Abzan will not tolerate Zurgo's marauders.
relations.quote: Remind Zurgo that the Abzan will not tolerate his marauders.

citation.text: Vanquish the Horde (Tarkir: Dragonstorm Commander, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: one of three wing leaders of Zurgo's warband
relations.quote: Batar Throatslasher was part of Zurgo 's warband

citation.text: "Batar Throatslasher", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: the partnership of dragonlord and despised outcast

citation.text: "Ojutai", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Closest advisor and wing leader until the desertion.
relations.quote: Varuk was an old, clever Mardu orc and Zurgo 's closest advisor.

citation.text: "Varuk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
